title: ComposedPromptBundle
description: Output contract for 100x-prompt-compose. One chosen template (from templates.json, 14 ids) + filled variables in -> one rendered, model-ready generation prompt out. Self-contained in this skill (no shared cross-skill schemas/ in this repo yet). NOTE (same split as 100x-search-query/100x-persona): vanilla JSON Schema draft-07 can enforce per-item shape (enums, required fields, additionalProperties, the reference-lock value/status pattern, the scene no-lighting-word pattern) but CANNOT (a) look up templates.json to verify rendered_body is a byte-for-byte reconstruction of the chosen template's body (axiom 1 -- needs an external file), (b) verify a 'reference_reuse' ref_number was actually established earlier (axiom 2 -- needs cross-array numeric set membership), or (c) scan against the per-model banned-word lists / duration caps documented in profiles/veo.md and profiles/seedance.md (axiom 4 -- a model-conditional word-list scan, kept in scripts/validate.js by the same convention 100x-search-query uses for its platform keyword-density tables, not duplicated into this schema). Those three are enforced by scripts/validate.js.

template_id.description: Must match a real id in templates.json. This enum is the authoritative id list; scripts/validate.js's --selftest cross-checks it against templates.json's own ids to catch drift if a template is ever added/removed without updating this schema.

template_name.description: Optional echo of templates.json's template.name, for human readability only.

category.description: Must match the chosen template's own category in templates.json (script cross-checks; schema can only constrain to the 3-value enum, not to 'the specific value templates.json declares for this template_id').

^(scene|scenes|place|rooms)$.pattern: ^(?!.*(明亮阳光|柔和灯光|柔光|暖光|冷光|逆光|顶光|侧光|自然光|摄影棚灯光|补光灯|bright sunlight|soft light|soft lighting|warm light|warm lighting|cool lighting|natural light|backlit|studio light|studio lighting|golden hour|ring light|softbox)).+$
^(scene|scenes|place|rooms)$.description: Axiom 3: scene-bearing variables (templates.json variable_glossary: scene/scenes/place/rooms) must not describe lighting -- lighting is controlled exclusively by realism_suffix (templates.json meta.hard_rules #4). Weather words are fine. This closed lighting-word list is authoritative here; scripts/validate.js reads this exact pattern back from this file instead of hand-copying it, mirroring 100x-persona's micro_coordinate vague-word design. 'natural light' (the direct English translation of the Chinese '自然光' entry) is included on this list alongside the Chinese keyword, maintaining symmetric coverage for English prompts.

variables_used.description: Map of template.variables[].key -> filled value, for the chosen template_id. Required (non-optional) keys are exactly templates.json's variables[] entries whose label does NOT contain '(可选)'; this per-template required-set check needs an external file lookup (templates.json) so it lives in scripts/validate.js's referential check, not here.

conditional_clauses.description: Optional. Resolved values of templates.json's per-template conditional[] fields (e.g. IMG-02's problem_clause, IMG-05's layout_desc, PART-HOOK's hook_clause), for auditability. scripts/validate.js recomputes these independently from templates.json + variables_used as part of the axiom-1 reconstruction check.

rendered_body.description: Axiom 1: must be byte-for-byte equal to templates.json's template.body with every {key} placeholder substituted (variables_used + resolved conditional_clauses + realism_suffix[suffix_key]), including the effect_library/hook_library bracket-expansion special cases for VID-A/VID-F/PART-HOOK documented in templates.json meta.render_notes. This already includes the realism_suffix text (it is an inline {realism_suffix} token inside body, not appended separately). Reconstruction requires reading templates.json, which this schema cannot do -- enforced by scripts/validate.js.

value.description: Axiom 2 format half (schema-checkable): a reference_reuse entry's value must be exactly the '参考图N产品/人物' shorthand, never a redescription. Whether N was actually established earlier (referential integrity) needs meta.existing_refs_input / earlier reference_locks entries, which is a cross-field lookup schema.json cannot express -- see scripts/validate.js checkReferenceLockIntegrity.
Axiom 2 format half: a first_lock entry must contain real descriptive content, not the reference shorthand (that shorthand is reserved for entities already established in a prior compose call).

reference_locks.description: Optional. Present only for templates whose variables include a lock-establishing field (product_desc/persona in IMG-01/IMG-02) or a lock-referencing field (product_lock/persona_ref). Empty/absent for templates with no lock semantics (e.g. VID-B, VID-E, VID-G, PART-HOOK, PART-CTA).

model.description: Video model wrapper choice. Must be null when category != '视频'. Must be one of the 3 known wrappers when category == '视频' (see 'category-model consistency' conditional below).

video_unit.description: Must be null when category != '视频' or model is null. Must be an object when category == '视频' (see conditional below). Per-model duration cap / banned-word / trailing-phrase compliance (axiom 4) is enforced by scripts/validate.js against profiles/veo.md and profiles/seedance.md's documented constants -- not duplicated into this schema, same convention 100x-search-query uses for its platform density word lists.

narrative_shot_type.description: Required only when model == '即创' (script-checked): the 7 narrative-shot categories from templates.json model_wrappers.即创. This skill holds no source material for 即创's duration cap or banned-word list -- known limitation, see SKILL.md.

existing_refs_input.description: Optional class-C echo of the ref numbers already established in prior compose calls this session (upstream context). Absent/empty means this call treats every lock-bearing variable as first_lock.

established_refs_after.description: This call's self-reported union of existing_refs_input plus any new first_lock ref_numbers created this call. scripts/validate.js verifies this union is arithmetically correct (axiom 2).

allOf.description: category-model consistency: image/通用件 templates never carry a model wrapper; video templates always do.
